We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.

- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment

- Be part of a supportive and collaborative IT team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth

About our client

Kogan People Solutions is delighted to partner with one of Australia’s leading Project Management and Advisory practices. Renowned for delivering complex, high-profile projects across both the public and private sectors, our client provides integrated advisory, project, and asset management solutions.

From city-shaping infrastructure to nation-building projects, they operate across the Social, Commercial, Transport, Utilities, and Energy sectors. With innovation and sustainability at the core of everything they do, they have become a trusted partner to iconic Australian businesses, Not-For-Profits, and all levels of Government.

Due to continued growth, they are now seeking a highly qualified and motivated Quantity Surveyor to join their team in Adelaide.

•	Location: Adelaide, SA

•	Work Type: Full-Time, Ongoing

•	Salary: $100,000 – $120,000 + Superannuation per annum (Negotiable based on experience)

Position Purpose

We are seeking a dedicated Quantity Surveyor to join our client’s Project Management and Advisory practice in Adelaide. The purpose of this role is to support the delivery of accurate measurement, estimating, and contract administration services across all project stages, ensuring high-quality cost planning and timely project outputs.

The successful candidate will contribute to effective project delivery by maintaining strong documentation, assisting with variation and 
progress claim processes, and supporting the broader quantity surveying team in achieving efficient, reliable, and client-focused outcomes.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

Operating across the full project lifecycle, the core duties of this position include:


•	Measurement & Cost Planning: Measuring quantities for estimates, cost plans, bills of quantities, and variations to required industry standards and accuracies. Preparing comprehensive cost plans, estimates, and associated reports.

•	Procurement & Tender Evaluation: Preparing bills of quantities to required standards, and actively assessing and analysing vendor/contractor tenders.

•	Post-Contract Administration: Providing direct assistance to quantity surveyors in undertaking contract administration services, including the measurement of variations, preparation of progress claims, and the resolution of post-contract certificates and variations.

•	Project Close-Out & Analysis: Managing costs and reporting during project construction phases, preparing final accounts, and conducting thorough post-project analyses to input into internal cost databases.

•	Specialised Financial Reporting: Preparing accurate tax depreciation schedules and independent bank reports.

•	Quality Assurance & Compliance: Assisting with Quality Assurance (QA) requirements, including documentation management and supporting internal audit requirements.

•	Operations & Communication: Attending project and consultant meetings as required. Maintaining open communication with all staff to facilitate ongoing professional training, ensuring efficient time management, and strictly meeting all project deadlines. Providing general administrative assistance around the office as necessary.

Statutory & Corporate Compliance

The candidate will be required to maintain the highest quality of work by strictly complying with:

•	Company Work Health and Safety (WH&S) Policies

•	Corporate Code of Conduct and Employee Handbook

•	Established Quality Assurance procedures and Group Standards

•	Behaviours consistently aligned with corporate values

Skills, Qualifications, and Experience Required

To be considered we expect to observe:

•	Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Quantity Surveying or a related construction discipline.

•	Minimum of 1+ years of post-qualification professional experience (preferably more).

•	Technical Skills: Proven proficiency and hands-on experience utilizing industry-standard digital quantity take-off and 5D BIM estimating software and Computer-Aided Design (CAD) platforms and 3D civil/spatial modelling tools

•	Soft Skills: Sharp time management skills with a proven track record of meeting strict deadlines; excellent written and verbal communication skills.

•	AIQS Registration or eligibility is highly regarded.

You must have unrestricted rights to work full-time in Australia.

What’s on Offer

•	Competitive salary negotiable for the right candidate.
•	Clear framework for corporate targets via a structured Professional Development Plan (PDP).
•	Exposure to city-shaping infrastructure and diverse public/private sector clients.
•	A supportive, collaborative, and forward-thinking team culture.

How to Apply

If you are ready to take the next step in your career with an industry leader, please apply via the facilities on this site, ensuring you attach your updated CV.

Please note: Kogan People Solutions appreciates all applications; however, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
